## Before activation
1. Apply 20260927_email_notifications.sql.
2. Select the Supabase Postgres credential in both SQL nodes.
3. Enable Gmail API and create Gmail OAuth2 credential for contact@flowrisedental.ro. Select it in Send with Gmail.
4. Configure app@flowrisedental.ro in Gmail Send mail as.
5. Enable preferences for a test user; create a test order and run manually.
6. Verify queue states and Gmail delivery, then activate.

Ten notifications per minute. Only HTTP 429 is retried (max 5 attempts). 5xx/timeouts become uncertain; check Sent mail before replay. Inspect failed/uncertain states in Supabase. Never retry a whole send execution blindly. No patient data in email.
